neighbours.label: Fires on a quantifier right after an existential or copula that singles out members of a set ('there are some tools', 'stamina is one worth...'); quiet when the same idea is said without that selecting quantifier.
fire: Before a long hike, there are some things you should always pack.
In every big city there are some neighborhoods worth exploring.
Among the old recipes, this soup is one my grandmother loved.
For new parents there are some books that really help.
If you ask me, there are some habits nobody should give up.
Of the three candidates, Patel is one the board trusts.
In this guide there are some steps you can safely skip.
Of all his films, the western is one critics still praise.
quiet: Before a long hike, I always pack water and a paper map.
In every big city the old neighborhoods deserve exploring.
Among the old recipes, this soup was my grandmother's favorite.
New parents often find books about sleep really helpful.
If you ask me, nobody should give up good habits.
Of the three candidates, Patel has the board's trust.
In this guide you can safely skip the third step.
Of all his films, critics still praise the western.

predictions: median fire ~0.35 (probes: 'there are some' 0.63, 'is one worth' 0.41; 'are two players' only 0.09); near misses < 0.1; risk: 'is the hardest' leaked 0.25, so near misses avoid 'is the'.
notes: Promotes ' that', ' ones', ' which': the quantifier sets up a relative clause picking items. Numerals after copula were weak, so fire items use 'some' and 'one'.
